Overview
This step down voltage converter lets you safely use 110V US appliances in over 150 countries by converting 220V-240V power down to 110V. The 2000W AC outlet handles household appliances like kettles and hair dryers, while the separate 200W adapter supports laptops and smartphones on 100V-240V dual voltage. Six international plug adapters are included covering Type C, G, I, L, D, and M outlets for use in Europe, UK, Australia, Italy, India, South Africa, Germany, China, Dubai, Greece, and New Zealand. Three AC outlets and four USB ports including one USB-C let you charge up to seven devices at once. Built-in protections guard against overcurrent and short circuits, and a silent cooling fan keeps the unit running without noise. Note: The 2000W AC outlets are not suitable for low wattage devices under 5W such as electric shavers or toothbrushes, and should not be used with devices over 200W or those with overvoltage protection.
